findings.F1: Inside the falling-agitated profile, a scaled 3-day rise is given back mostly over the next 3 days. On the 3-day grid, the excess return falls as the rise grows: slope -0.0318, t -2.2, 180 rise cases, mean excess -1.02 %. The top quintile of the scaled 3-day move (mean 1.32 usual moves) is followed by -3.00 % excess, t -3.01, 58 cases. The slope on all cases is negative on every one of the 3 grid offsets, with t from -1.59 to -0.86.
findings.F2: At the tested 15-day horizon, rises in the profile are followed by lower prices, but the size of the rise does not grade the outcome. Rise cases show a mean excess of -12.69 %, yet the slope among rises only is +0.0141, t 0.4, 42 cases. Across grid offsets the 15-day slope ranges from t -2.71 to +2.11, and only 67 % of offsets are negative. This is why the tested slope only reached t 1.21.
findings.F3: Inside the profile, large scaled 3-day falls rebound. The bottom quintile (mean -1.26 usual moves) is followed by +3.02 % excess over 3 days, t 2.38, 91 cases, and by +12.37 % over 15 days, t 3.06, 26 cases. The map already holds this effect (035-01, 038-01, 047-01, 051-01, falling agitated, long), so it is not a discovery.
findings.F4: Outside the profile, scaled 3-day moves continue rather than reverse. Over 3 days the slope is +0.0090, t 4.79, 2261 cases, and the top quintile earns +1.36 % excess, t 3.15, 480 cases. Over 15 days the slope is +0.0576, t 4.03, 388 cases.
findings.F5: The continuation outside the profile is strongest in falling, calm markets (60-day trend below -10 %, swing not above its yearly median). There the 15-day slope of excess return on the scaled 3-day move is +0.1114, t 3.31, 82 cases. After rises the excess is +27.2 % (8 cases) and after falls -6.98 % (18 cases). The 3-day slope there is +0.0122, t 1.69, 458 cases. The map lists only one strategy in falling calm (035-01.b1).
findings.F6: The book stays short long after the signal has faded, which is why it gives back the 3-day give-back of F1. In the profile the forecast is below 0 on only 39.3 % of bars, but the position is short on 83.9 %. Its 245 short trades lost 5.09 % on average after fees, with a median of -1.46 %, and in 2020 and 2021 the book lost 0.078 % and 0.006 % a day.

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, the larger a coin's 3-day rise is against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the larger the fall in its price over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would treat a large scaled few-day rally in a falling, agitated market as a reason to short or refuse longs for the next few days only, not for two weeks.
ideas.name: rally giveback over three days

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, the larger a coin's 3-day move is against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the further its price continues in that same direction over the next 15 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would follow a large scaled few-day move in a falling, calm market for two weeks rather than fade it.
ideas.name: falling calm move continuation
